title: Jab himmat tute, Salasar Balaji
style: 3D animated devotional movie style, Pixar quality, soft cinematic lighting, rich warm colours, no text, no letters, no writing
hook: Himmat tute, Salasar Balaji hain na

scenes.prompt: Close-up darshan of the Salasar Balaji Hanuman murti: orange-vermilion Hanuman ji with a round gentle face, a long beard and moustache, a silver crown, heavy marigold garlands, in a dark quiet sanctum lit only by small brass diyas, deep shadows, warm golden glow, face in the middle of the frame
scenes.tts: जब हिम्मत टूटे, सालासर बालाजी का नाम लो।
scenes.sub: Jab himmat tute, Salasar Balaji ka naam lo.
scenes.animate: a very slow gentle camera push-in, the face stays still and serene, the diya flames flicker softly, the golden glow gently pulses

scenes.prompt: Darshan of the Salasar Balaji Hanuman murti, orange-vermilion Hanuman ji with a beard and moustache, silver crown and marigold garlands, slightly wider view in a dark sanctum with many glowing brass diyas in front, warm golden light
scenes.tts: चूरू, राजस्थान के सालासर में दाढ़ी-मूँछ वाले बालाजी।
scenes.sub: Churu, Rajasthan ke Salasar mein daadhi-moochh wale Balaji.
scenes.animate: a very slow gentle camera push-in, the face stays still and serene, many diya flames flicker softly, a few marigold petals drift in the background

scenes.prompt: A single brass diya flame glowing in a dark quiet temple sanctum, soft golden light on old stone, red vermilion and marigold petals beside it, warm shadows, calm and hopeful mood, no people
scenes.tts: मन भारी हो… तो एक दीया जलाओ, और बालाजी को याद करो।
scenes.sub: Man bhaari ho… to ek diya jalao, aur Balaji ko yaad karo.
scenes.animate: the diya flame flickers softly, a thin wisp of incense smoke rises slowly, marigold petals rest still

scenes.tts: जय श्री राम! अच्छा लगे तो लाइक, शेयर और सब्सक्राइब करें। जय सालासर बालाजी!
scenes.sub: Jai Shree Ram! Achha lage to Like, Share aur Subscribe karein. Jai Salasar Balaji!

Salasar Balaji Dham (Churu, Rajasthan) ke darshan. Jab himmat tute, bhakt Hanuman ji ko, Salasar ke Balaji ko yaad karte hain.
सालासर बालाजी धाम, चूरू: दाढ़ी-मूँछ वाले हनुमान जी के दर्शन 🙏
ॐ श्री हनुमते नमः
Chitra AI dwara banaye gaye hain (sanketik).
Jai Shree Shyam 🙏
Video achha lage to Like, Share aur Subscribe karein.
#SalasarBalaji #Hanuman #JaiBalaji #Rajasthan
